svg.text: British Auction RFQ System — Database Schema
PostgreSQL 16 · 8 tables · crow's-foot notation · all timestamps are UTC timestamptz · money is numeric(14,2) · ids are uuid (gen_random_uuid)

g.text: Rotated on every use; reusing an old token revokes the family
supplier_id is filled once the invitee has an account
X and Y between 1 and 1440 minutes
Append-only activity log · id is the live-update sequence

Buyer who sent the sign-up link

Invitee's account, filled in once they have one
Who performed the action (empty for the worker)
